newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank to increase mortagages 50 pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China bank to increase mortagages 50 pct in 1997.

text.p: The state-owned Shanghai Construction Bank plans to increase its private home mortgages to around three billion yuan in 1997, 50 percent up on 1996, the official Business News said on Thursday.
"In order to satisfy public demand, the Shanghai Construction Bank will move towards commercialisation by providing housing services," the newspaper said.
The bank issued 2.2 billion yuan in private and state enterprise employee home mortgage loans in 1996, it said.
The mortgage loans were drawn from 12.6 billion yuan in mutual-help funds, money set aside by state enterprises to finance employee housing, said the newspaper.
Mutual-help funds also provided 5.8 billion yuan in work-unit housing loans and 1.25 billion yuan in low-income housing assistance, it said.
The Shanghai Construction Bank is a branch of the China Construction Bank, one of the country's largest state banks, which specialises in construction and housing investment.
